c74object.name: jam.ilda.compose
c74object.digest: Parse SVG file to ILDA file format
c74object.description: Parse SVG file to ILDA file format.

method.name: scale
method.digest: Scale a frame
method.description:
Scale a frame. If one argument follows the message x and y axis are scaled by that value. If 2 arguments are present the first argument specifies the scaling along the x-axis, the second along the y-axis.
Note: All frame modifications are done destructively, meaning information lost e.g. by scaling to 0 cannot be recovered by scaling up again.

method.name: reverse
method.digest: Reverse the order of the frames
method.description: Reverse the order of the frames

method.name: ilda
method.digest: Reference to am ILDA file loaded by [jam.ilda.file]
method.description: Reference to am ILDA file loaded by [jam.ilda.file]. The frames from the file will be appended. When imported frames use indexed colors, they are converted to true color mode

method.name: bezier
method.digest: Draw a cubic bezier curve into a frame
method.description: Draw a cubic bezier curve into a frame

method.name: rect
method.digest: Draw a rectangle into a frame
method.description: Draw a rectangle into a frame

method.name: ellipse
method.digest: Draw an ellipse into a frame
method.description: Draw an ellipse into a frame

method.name: duplicateframe
method.digest: Duplicate a frame
method.description: Duplicate a frame. If no argument is provided the currently set edit frame is duplicated. If one argument [frame index] is present, the frame at index will be duplicated.

method.name: svg
method.digest: Parse a SVG file into the current edit frame
method.description: Parse a SVG file into the current edit frame.

method.name: moveto
method.digest: Move to point x/y without drawing a line
method.description: Move to point x/y without drawing a line. (laser is blanked)

method.name: copyframe
method.digest: Copy a frame
method.description: Copy a frame. The message 'copyframe' followed by two arguments source_index destination_index copies a frame from source_index to destination_index

method.name: appendframe
method.digest: Append a new frame
method.description: Append a new frame

method.name: export
method.digest: Write the frames to ILDA file
method.description: Write the frames to ILDA file. If no path/filename is provided, a dialog will be presented. A success/failure notification will be sent to the rightmost outlet in the form export filename 0/1.

method.name: circle
method.digest: Draw a circle into a frame
method.description: Draw a circle into a frame

method.name: seteditframe
method.digest: Select frame to be edited
method.description: Select frame to be edited

method.name: rotate
method.digest: Rotate a frame
method.description: Rotate a frame. If one argument follows the message, the frame will be rotated around the center point. If three arguments are present, the sencond and third arguments specify the rotation center

method.name: line
method.digest: Draw a line into a frame
method.description: Draw a line into a frame

method.name: removeframe
method.digest: Remove frame a frame
method.description: Remove frame a frame. If no argument is provided the currently set edit frame is removed. If one argument [frame index] is present, the frame at index will be duplicated.

method.name: clear
method.digest: Remove all frames
method.description: Remove all frames

method.name: geteditframe
method.digest: Outputs the currenlty selected frame for editing to the second outlet
method.description: Outputs the currenlty selected frame for editing to the second outlet

method.name: bang
method.digest: Output ILDA file reference
method.description: Output ILDA file reference

attribute.name: companyname
attribute.digest:
Company name set in the headers of the ILDA file.
ILDA files contain of a sequence of 'frames'
attribute.description:
Company name set in the headers of the ILDA file.
ILDA files contain of a sequence of 'frames'. Every frame has a header summarizing some information about the frame. This attribute sets the value of the header field 'Company Name' (max 8 ASCII characters).

attribute.name: frameprefix
attribute.digest:
Frame name prefix set in the header of the ILDA file.
ILDA files contain of a sequence of 'frames'
attribute.description:
Frame name prefix set in the header of the ILDA file.
ILDA files contain of a sequence of 'frames'. Every frame has a header summarizing some information about the frame. Every frame has a frame-name field in the header. jam.ilda.compose names frames automatically by setting the frame number as its name. This attribute sets an optioname prefix to the frame name (max 3 ASCII characters).
